decisions.reason: The source changes post-mint success-modal wording and merely describes the already-current random $5 commission and ticket behavior.
The source addresses feedback shown after random rewards have been sent, not the distinct pre-mint referral-validation message stating what will happen.
Mention of the NFT title and reward mechanics occurs only within success-modal copy and does not change landing-page hero messaging.
The source does not change certificate actions, ebook access, confirmation-email availability, or confirmation-email contents.
The client specifies success-modal text rather than requesting any FAQ copy change.
The source does not alter the mint price, revenue split, commission amount, or prize-pool allocation.
The source concerns a no-referral mint and does not change rewards for successful coded referrals.
The source presumes that random rewards were sent but does not change their required accounting on leaderboards, dashboards, or NFT attributes.
The source does not change the NFT mint number's use, persistence, or display as the referral code.
The requested wording is for a transaction-success modal, not the landing-page mechanics or prize sections.
The source conditionally specifies feedback after a transaction and reward distribution; it does not change the asset that must be minted or mint fulfillment behavior.
The source contains no change to optional tipping, its transaction timing, or its disclosure.
